quests.title: Antigonus

dialogue.t: You two are...
Are you Antei?
That's right. That's me. I feel... a little strange...
I remember chasing those scoundrels... ripping a core out and throwing it into a camp. Then after that, I got a little woozy from my own injuries... I was hurt pretty bad...
But then I woke up, and then I met you, and now I feel fine. Tell me, am I going to die soon or something?
...No, that's not important right now. Are you here to arrest me again? I've already proven my innocence.
It was those people from Khaenri'ah. They were the ones who stole that library book. I was assigned as one of their bodyguards, sure, but there's no way I would have been in cahoots with them!
I tracked their diplomatic team to this place and beat them all.
But I spent a long time dealing with some giant mechanical creature they had with them. Finally, I was able to tear its core out, but I was wounded seriously in the process.
The disabled machine crashed on top of the lost book. There's no way to retrieve it now.
Wow, Byakuyakoku's Jibashiri are pretty tough...

Wait, you aren't Jibashiri or candidates yourselves? *sigh* Whatever. The Jibashiri started out as heroes who fought against the Bathysmal Vishaps. It was only later that they became law enforcement — the judges of the nether.
The machine's core is in the camp. Go there and have a look if you don't believe me.
I once heard a Narukami Island envoy talk about this creature named a "bird." It has wings and it can fly through the skies.
That's just amazing, can you imagine it?
Some people believe that they are messengers from the gods who carry word of human fates.
And if some exiled person finally expires out in the wild, the very same creature will come to peck and consume their mortal flesh.
These animals fascinate me, to be honest. If I should see the light of another day, I will definitely keep a bird.
Did you get the book?
We did. You're indeed innocent, Antei.
From how you spoke earlier, you aren't Jibashiri... Which is a shame. You could've declared me innocent on the spot otherwise.
That would have saved me some time.
Again, I feel really energized, but I'm quite sure that I was exhausted from losing too much blood just a while ago. I just can't shake the feeling that I'm going to die shortly...
Uh...
*sigh* Let me ask you a question, stranger. Does a man sin who has been wrongly convicted by Byakuyakoku?
If I, due to my disturbed state of mind, was left here by Tokoyo Ookami as a Sinshade. Is this transgression?
Am I guilty?
Be careful {NICKNAME}. If he realizes that... you know, then he's gonna disappear.

dialogue.sit: You're just an afterimage that Antei left behind.
You are innocent, and I will make sure the world knows that.

dialogue.t: Haha. So that's it? So, I'm just a shadow, left behind after my death.
And... I am innocent.
